trigger: Use phase-aligned diagnostics and competing hypotheses to distinguish contact, instability and numerical failure.
procedure: Warning order or a final contact sample does not identify the initiating cause. Contact can trigger instability, follow it, or interact with it.
Inspect pre-failure state, actual contact frames/forces, input timing and solver records when available. Missing records remain missing; do not infer a causal history.
M6 distinguishes incomplete execution from valid but failed replay. PHS-2D shows that small motion or drift can coexist with unacceptable force residuals and switching sensitivity.
Matched fixed-input, time-step or active-set comparisons can be discriminating when authorized; simultaneous physical and numerical changes cannot isolate a mechanism.
